payload.description: The day whose matrix is wanted; when left out, the newest matrices of any day.

reply.description: With a day, that day's matrix, or none; without one, at most 20 matrices, newest day first. Each is whole as matrix.changed carries it.

day.description: The journal day the matrix is kept with, as its date; it never changes.

from.description: The day of the earlier matrix this one was copied from, without its ticked tasks. Absent on a matrix that started empty.

text.description: The task in the user's own words.

place.description: Where the user put the task: do (urgent and important), schedule (important, not urgent), delegate (urgent, not important) or drop (neither). Only ever set by the user; null while the user has not placed it.

done.description: Whether the user ticked the task.

suggested.description: Where the app suggests the task goes while the user has not placed it, written only by the matrices fact. A task without a place shows at this place; with neither, it shows in To sort.

sure.description: False when the answer was too close to call, shown as Not sure.

tasks.description: The tasks, in the order they stand inside each place.

pending.description: A change the server has not acknowledged yet (5).

total.description: How many matrices match in all, of which the reply holds at most 20.

tool.description: Returns the reader's Eisenhower Matrices, newest day first: each is kept with one journal day (its date) and holds that day's tasks in the reader's own words, each with its place (do: urgent and important; schedule: important, not urgent; delegate: urgent, not important; drop: neither), whether it is done (ticked), and, while the reader has not placed it, the place the app suggests and whether that suggestion is sure. A task with no place shows in its suggested place; with neither it is still to sort. A matrix copied from an earlier day names that day in from. Give day (YYYY-MM-DD) for one journal day's matrix, or nothing for the 20 newest; total says how many there are in all.
tool.label: Reading your Eisenhower Matrix
tool.title: Eisenhower Matrix
